panels.title: approval queue age
panels.description: Not a Prometheus series: scrape GET /approvals (records carry requested_at) — metrics cannot name instances, the queue can.

options.content:
**Approval queue age** is instance data, not a metric.

`GET /approvals` (guarded, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) lists the queue with `requested_at`; the oldest record's age is the queue age. Alert line: `> 3600s`.
